attestation.reason: NO_ATTESTATION: no operator attestation of the mapping was supplied

measured_from_the_committed_capture.door_state_segment_counts_reading: a *_AS_REPORTED segment is the device's own reported level, not a physically named door state; this block's own attestation is present=false, trustworthy=false, so no segment here may be quoted as OPEN or CLOSED

mc38_cross_check.meaning: MC-38 transitions are the machine ground truth only if the device's own cycle counter agrees with the detected edge count; a mismatch means an edge was missed

polarity_inversion.conclusion: no frames carry both door_raw and a confirmed polarity

contact_inversion.action_required: the H8 bench owner must commit the driver source
contact_inversion.assertion_basis: docs/01 §8.1 (door semantics are subject to the actual polarity mapping) and §8.2 (neither HIGH=OPEN nor LOW=OPEN may be assumed without physical verification), plus the mapping table this module carries
contact_inversion.claim: the two shipped polarity settings assign opposite door states to every raw level, so a capture cannot establish its own door narrative
contact_inversion.closes_when: the owning branch commits the door driver, after which the inversion is verifiable from tracked source
contact_inversion.why_not_citable: that file is not git-tracked on any ref in this repository; it exists only in a sibling working tree, so it may not be quoted as the proof of a published claim

note: this record states a gap; it is not a measurement of a disturbance
reason: no committed capture contains a door-open event: the only real thermal capture reports door_open=0 in 940 frames and UNKNOWN in 17, with zero OPEN segments, so there is no edge to align a response to

what_is_computable_instead.reading: the detection floor is measured; the door->response distribution is not, and publishing one would be inventing it
